description: Repo-relative, case-sensitive full-path globs: * excludes /, ** includes /, **/ includes zero directories, ? matches one non-slash. First match wins. Every earlier rule overlapping a later different destination must declare override: true; classify validates this for every supplied path. No universal fallback: unknown directory roots fail closed. original records the pre-S4 standard-side destination of reclassified product code, per 5481/5488; the external handoff plan is not vendored. Text lines count newline terminators plus a nonempty final line; binary (NUL) files have zero lines; symlinks count their stored link text.
